by: Claude Code (opus), titles and abstracts only

question.population: Children or adults (any age; not people already ill with COVID-19 or in hospital)
question.intervention: Vitamin D (D3, D2 or calcifediol) to prevent infection
question.outcome: Acute respiratory infections (colds, flu, chest infections, pneumonia)

question.population: Adults in general or older adults (not a group defined by one illness, such as people in intensive care, on dialysis or with cancer)
